svg.title: Selected work: REAMUS, ORBIS, TAD COIN, QB READER, ZEP, CORTIS
svg.desc: REAMUS (reamus.app): HTML to PDF, as an API. ORBIS (orbis-dev.netlify.app): Discord bots for developer workflows. TAD COIN (tad-coin.netlify.app): A coin named after Terry A. Davis. QB READER (github.com/qbreader/website): Quiz bowl practice. I do the web client. ZEP (github.com/wbrous/zep): A general-purpose Discord bot. CORTIS (NOT RELEASED): A messaging app for developers.
